message:
fix for counter type rendering as INT (#388)

closes #367

pr.title: fix for counter type rendering as INT

linkedIssues.title: Counter incorrectly renders value in help
linkedIssues.body:
I have a verbose flag defined something like:

```go
type Cmd struct {
  Verbose int `type:"counter"`
}
```

According to the [tests](https://github.com/alecthomas/kong/blob/master/model_test.go#L63), the help for this command should render as:

```
  --verbose
```

But it actually renders as:

```
  --verbose=INT
```

After much digging, I tracked the issue down to [here](https://github.com/alecthomas/kong/blob/master/help.go#L514-L516). This is where the flag is actually rendered in help, as opposed to [Flag.String](https://github.com/alecthomas/kong/blob/master/model.go#L405-L414) which actually appears to be wholly unused when building help.

Would it be possible to make the help omit the value and avoid users thinking they should specify the value for counters?

For the record, I'm using:
- Kong: v0.8.0
- Go v1.20.5

explanation.what: help.go の formatFlag() に isCounter := flag.IsCounter() を追加し、bool フラグに加えて counter 型のフラグでも `=VALUE` プレースホルダをヘルプ表示から省くようにした(`if !isBool && !isCounter` の条件に変更)。
explanation.why: リンクされた issue #367 が報告する通り、`type:"counter"` を指定したフラグ(例: `Verbose int \`type:"counter"\``)がヘルプ上で `--verbose=INT` のように誤った値プレースホルダ付きで表示される不具合を修正するもの。counter は `-v -v -v` のように値を取らず繰り返し指定で加算する用途のため、bool と同様に値表示は不要という判断。

highlights.note: isBool 判定の隣に isCounter を追加し、プレースホルダ抑制条件を拡張
